notionVersion.description: The [API version](/reference/versioning) to use for this request. The latest version is `2026-03-11`.
notionVersion.name: Notion-Version

agent_id.description: The ID of the parent agent.

block_id.description: The ID of the parent block.

owner.description: Details about the owner of the bot.

user.description: Details about the owner of the bot, when the `type` of the owner is `user`. This means the bot is for a integration.

avatar_url.description: The avatar URL of the user.

person.description: The person info of the user.

workspace.description: Details about the owner of the bot, when the `type` of the owner is `workspace`. This means the bot is for an internal integration.

workspace_id.description: The ID of the bot's workspace.

workspace_limits.description: Limits and restrictions that apply to the bot's workspace

max_file_upload_size_in_bytes.description: The maximum allowable size of a file upload, in bytes

workspace_name.description: The name of the bot's workspace.

bot.description: Details about the bot, when the `type` of the user is `bot`.

type.description: Indicates this user is a bot.

width_ratio.description: Ratio between 0 and 1 of the width of this column relative to all columns in the list. If not provided, uses an equal width.

custom_emoji.description: The custom emoji details for the icon.

type.description: Type of icon. In this case, a custom emoji.

id.description: The ID of the custom emoji.

name.description: The name of the custom emoji.

url.description: The URL of the custom emoji.

data_source_id.description: The ID of the parent data source.

database_id.description: The ID of the data source's parent database.
The ID of the parent database.

end.description: The end date of the date object, if any.

start.description: The start date of the date object.

time_zone.description: The time zone of the date object.

emoji.description: The emoji character used as the icon.

type.description: Type of icon. In this case, an emoji.

equation.description: Notion supports inline LaTeX equations as rich text objects with a type value of `equation`.

external.description: The external URL for the icon.

url.description: The URL of the external file or resource.

type.description: Type of icon. In this case, an external URL.

file.description: The file URL for the icon.

type.description: Type of icon. In this case, a file.

icon.description: The Notion native icon, specified by name and color.

type.description: Type of icon. In this case, a Notion native icon.

expiry_time.description: The time when the URL will expire.

height.description: The height of the link preview iframe.

href.description: The href of the link mention.

icon_url.description: The icon URL of the link.

iframe_url.description: The iframe URL of the link.

padding.description: The padding of the link preview iframe.

padding_top.description: The top padding of the link preview iframe.

thumbnail_url.description: The thumbnail URL of the link.

url.description: The URL of the link preview mention.

mention.description: Mention objects represent an inline mention of a database, date, link preview mention, page, template mention, or user. A mention is created in the Notion UI when a user types `@` followed by the name of the reference.

link_preview.description: Details of the link preview mention.

id.description: The ID of the page in the mention.
The ID of the database in the mention.

custom_emoji.description: Details of the custom emoji mention.

color.description: The color variant of the icon. Valid values: gray, lightgray, brown, yellow, orange, green, blue, purple, pink, red.

name.description: The name of the Notion icon (e.g. pizza, meeting, home). See the Notion icon picker for valid names.

page_id.description: The ID of the parent page.

person.description: Details about the person, when the `type` of the user is `person`.

type.description: Indicates this user is a person.

annotations.description: All rich text objects contain an annotations object that sets the styling for the rich text.

href.description: A URL that the rich text object links to or mentions.

plain_text.description: The plain text content of the rich text object, without any styling.

template_mention_date.description: The date of the template mention.

template_mention_user.description: The user of the template mention.

text.description: If a rich text object's type value is `text`, then the corresponding text field contains an object including the text content and any inline link.

content.description: The actual text content of the text.

link.description: An object with information about any inline link in this text, if included.

block_type.description: The underlying block type that is not currently supported by the Public API. Example values include: form, button, drive.

avatar_url.description: The avatar URL of the user.
